reason: A host-only DSH plugin that wraps Playwright CLI operations for version checks, browser installation, test execution, and HTML report access.

summaries.zh: 通过宿主 shell 封装 Playwright CLI，支持检测版本、安装浏览器、运行测试并访问 HTML 报告。
summaries.en: A host-side wrapper for the Playwright CLI that checks versions, installs browsers, runs tests, and provides access to HTML reports.

capabilities: Detects the locally available Playwright CLI version
Installs Playwright browsers and may install @playwright/test when configured
Executes Playwright test commands through the host shell executor
Serves or exposes generated HTML test reports through a loopback route
Can request broader sandbox permissions after a sandbox denial
